instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of an indoor office lounge. An older woman with short white hair (R2) in a gray blazer sits on the left of a black leather sofa, looking intently at a document. Next to her on the right, a bearded man in a gray plaid suit (R1) holds the white paper and gestures with his hand while speaking. A wooden coffee table with a laptop sits in the foreground. The scene is captured with soft indoor lighting and a neutral color palette.
